goals.disclaimer: Goals only count as demonstrated after a checkpoint; the starting-point check gives estimates. Goal alignments in this app are CEFR-aligned estimates — not an official CEFR examination or certification.
goals.domain.technical: {name} — {shown}; needs a device that can recognize {language} speech. This is a device limit, not a result.
goals.group.estimatedHint: Estimates only — a checkpoint can confirm them.
goals.limits1: • It is a CEFR-aligned estimate from this course's own deterministic checks, scored on your latest attempt at each check — never an official CEFR examination, certificate, or Council of Europe endorsement.
goals.limits2: • Speaking and conversation checks need a device that can recognize {language} speech. If yours can't, those parts are skipped: the estimate stays incomplete, and nothing is ever counted as a failure.
goals.limits3: • Retaking a check replaces your standing with the newest result — a different parallel version where one exists — and earlier attempts are kept, never re-scored.
goals.limits4: • A full CEFR level covers more situations and spontaneity than any app can sample. Treat this as an honest map of what you have shown here, not a qualification.

goals.noteDemonstrated: You have shown every required goal in all five skill areas in this course's own checks. This is a course-based estimate — an official level comes only from an accredited examination.
goals.noteIncomplete: An A1 estimate needs every required goal shown in all five skill areas — one good check is a start, not the whole area. Still to show: {domains}. A skipped speaking part just leaves the estimate incomplete — it never counts against you.

licenses.audioBody: Word, sentence and listening audio is synthesized when the app is built, with Piper (rhasspy/piper, MIT License) and the voices below; sound effects are generated tone sequences. Courses without a license-cleared voice (Italian, Japanese, Korean, Chinese) use your device's own speech synthesis. No audio is fetched at runtime.
licenses.lexiconBody: The {language} lexicon dataset (word metadata, pronunciation, examples) is published under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 license ({license}). This license covers the dataset only — it does not change the app's software licensing.
licenses.lexiqueBody: Word frequency and IPA pronunciation values are derived from Lexique 4 (New, Pallier, Schalchli, Bourgin, & Gimenes, 2026 — lexique.org), distributed under CC BY-SA 4.0. Modifications: selection of the curriculum entries, per-word matching to Lexique rows, frequency banding derived from the corpus distribution, and integration with this app's authored lexicon. Full provenance is recorded in ATTRIBUTIONS.md and the repository's content/fr/lexicon documentation.
licenses.softwareBody: Based on Lingo Lessons by Open Apps Studio, used under the MIT License. The original LICENSE file — including the 650 Industries, Inc. notice from the create-expo-app template — is preserved in the project repository, alongside the full generated ATTRIBUTIONS.md. Spaced-repetition scheduling is powered by ts-fsrs (open-spaced-repetition contributors, MIT License).
